description: List the operations THIS client requested through this API for a Proxmox VPS (power, reinstall, password, backups, snapshots), newest first, up to 20. Each entry is a fixed operation kind plus the UTC instant the provider ACCEPTED it; the list never claims an outcome — read impreza_vps_status for the current state. Read-only.
name: impreza_vps_events
title: VPS recent operations
